{{Quote|Master Lorenn was just ice. You had no idea if he even knew you were in the room.|Languss Tuno|<ref name="Notoriety" />}}
'''Lorenn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who ran a recruitment center on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. He recruited the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] con artist [[Languss Tuno]] and took him as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], though Tuno later abandoned his training and left the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], stealing Lorenn's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Personality==
{{Quote|Idiots like his old Master turn gold into dross.|Isaac to the Outlander regarding Lorenn's teaching style|<ref name="Notoriety" />}}
According to his Padawan Languss Tuno, he was distant to his students, as well as an exacting and strict teacher.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> According to Languss' subsequent teacher, the "Force Master" known as [[Isaac (Human)|Isaac]], Lorenn's style of teaching consisted of rigidly setting instructions and adherence to traditional Jedi values and techniques rather than allowing his students to adapt and think on their own, which in some cases drove away Padawans with hidden talents that could not be reached through traditional Jedi training.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>{{Char-stub}}
